label: A concrete-empty moment is followed only by concrete-empty moments
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred: in every history of the model, if no concrete individual is present at a moment, then no concrete individual is present at any strictly later moment of that history. It mentions no cause, ground or explanation, and it does not constrain a first state that has no earlier moment. Reading of presence (attempt c94eed5b, PR #1493): History.IsAt is read inclusively, as actual in the history and bearing on the moment, by location at it (a temporal thing) or co-presence to it (a non-temporal agent). On that reading a concrete-empty moment also lacks co-present concrete beings, so the antecedent is rarer and the consequent harder to meet (the shift does not order this premise by strength), and the necessary concrete individual of Arrival A may be a non-temporal being co-present to the moment. A1 (presence implies existence in the history) accepts the reading; A3 concerns contingent things and is unaffected.
